Rune Trangbæk is a medical doctor and evidence specialist based at Zealand University Hospital (Sjællands Universitetshospital) in Køge, Region Zealand [^src1]. He serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], representing the Danish Surgical Society (Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab) [^src1]. His role on the committee is significant because it brings evidence-based methodological expertise to the development and governance of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) [^src1]. Trangbæk is listed in the 2023 AKDB annual report among the multidisciplinary steering group members who oversee the database's clinical indicators, operational frameworks, and cross-regional quality assurance efforts [^src1].
